verdict: Meta delivered 125 leads; Google's $1,678 spend is being fixed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 125 leads at a cost of $23.12 per lead — all of them driven by Meta, which is carrying your paid program on its own. Google Ads ran $1,677.93 in spend this period and recorded zero conversions; this is a confirmed conversion tracking issue, not an ads performance problem, and it is being resolved with offline conversion import going live by end of August. Spend rose 28% in the most recent week and brought 15% more leads with it, though cost per lead climbed 11% as a result — efficiency is being monitored closely as that spend level holds. Next period, with Google tracking repaired and new creative in market, you should see a clearer picture of full-funnel performance across both channels.
